title: Locality of Shamir reconstruction
statement: Let $F$ be a field and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. In the Shamir scheme over $F$ with parameter $k$, reconstruction from a finite set $A$ of parties depends only on the shares held by parties in $A$: whenever two share functions agree on every party in $A$, reconstruction from $A$ gives the same result for both.
hypotheses_covered: The two share functions agree on every party in the finite set $A$
